sections.heading: Shabana Azmi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shabana Azmi was born on 18 September 1950 in Azamgarh, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Kaifi Azmi and her mother, Shaukat Kaifi. She is a sibling of Baba Azmi.
Her listed education includes St. Xavier's College, Film and Television Institute of India, University of Mumbai and Queen Mary School, Mumbai.

sections.heading: Shabana Azmi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists film actor, stage actor, singer, public figure and politician as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Shabana are Ankur, Amar Akbar Anthony, Swami, Arth, Masoom, Libaas, Fire, Godmother, Morning Raga and 15 Park Avenue.
She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (1997–2003).
